skill.name: context-driven-development
skill.description: Use this skill to create and maintain Conductor context artifacts for AI-assisted software development.
skill.summary: Guide Conductor teams through context-driven development artifacts, validation, and session continuity.
skill.author: wshobson

content.value_statement: AI-assisted projects lose consistency when context lives in scattered notes. This skill provides a structured Conductor workflow for product, stack, workflow, and track artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Explains how product.md, product-guidelines.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, and tracks.md relate.
Guides greenfield and brownfield setup with Conductor context artifacts.
Provides checklists for validating product, technical, workflow, and track context.
Describes when to update context artifacts during feature work and dependency changes.
Recommends session continuity practices for starting, ending, and resuming development work.
limitations: Does not include executable scripts or automated validators.
Assumes the Conductor artifact structure and slash commands are available.
Cannot infer actual project facts without reading repository context.
Does not replace human review of product, architecture, or workflow decisions.

use_cases.title: Start a New AI-Assisted Project
use_cases.description: Create a clear context foundation before implementation begins, including product goals, technology choices, workflow rules, and track structure.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Context
use_cases.description: Align product, engineering, and documentation decisions so AI assistants and team members follow the same project rules.

use_cases.title: Refresh Existing Project Documentation
use_cases.description: Review brownfield codebases, identify outdated context, and update Conductor artifacts before planning new work.

prompt_templates.title: Create Initial Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use context-driven-development to help me create Conductor context artifacts for a new project. Ask for product goals, users, technology preferences, and workflow needs.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Current Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Check whether existing artifacts are ready for implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Conductor context artifacts for consistency. Flag outdated product, technical, workflow, or track information before I start implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Brownfield Context Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Apply the method to an existing codebase.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use context-driven-development for an existing project. Identify what context can be inferred from the repository and what needs stakeholder confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Synchronize Context After Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: A feature track is complete. Help me update product, tech-stack, workflow, tracks, and session notes so the Conductor context stays synchronized.

output_examples.input: I need to add payments, but my project context is outdated.
output: Review product.md for payment goals and success metrics.
Check tech-stack.md for payment dependencies and version constraints.
Update workflow.md if review or deployment gates change.
Create or update the relevant track before implementation starts.

output_examples.input: Our team keeps giving AI assistants different project instructions.
output: Move shared product decisions into product.md.
Document language, dependency, and infrastructure choices in tech-stack.md.
Capture team practices and quality gates in workflow.md.
Use tracks.md to show active work and status.

best_practices: Read the relevant context artifacts before planning or coding work.
Update context documents as part of each completed track.
Keep artifacts focused on decisions that guide AI behavior and team alignment.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation before verifying product, technical, and workflow context.
Creating duplicate documents instead of updating the canonical Conductor artifacts.
Letting one person own context updates without team review.

faq.question: What is context-driven development?
faq.answer: It treats project context as a maintained artifact that guides planning, implementation, and AI-assisted work.

faq.question: Which Conductor files does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers product.md, product-guidelines.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, tracks.md, and track-level planning files.

faq.question: Can this skill generate project facts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure and validate context, but project facts must come from the repository and stakeholders.

faq.question: Is this only for new projects?
faq.answer: No. It supports greenfield setup and brownfield projects that need context extraction and cleanup.

faq.question: How does it help Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: It gives these tools consistent project context, reducing repeated explanations and conflicting instructions.

faq.question: Does it run commands or change files by itself?
faq.answer: No. The skill is guidance-only and describes how to manage Conductor artifacts.
